thread:
lina: Quick all-hands follow-up thread for pricing/packaging/usage questions. Drop short follow-ups and we'll triage.
sam: Quick one: what's the exact expiry window for promo/trial credits? Customers keep asking if they auto-renew.
julia: Legal/Finance: standard is 12 months from grant. No auto-renew. Exceptions are explicit in promo terms. Credits are non-transferable. We'll add a short FAQ blurb.
maya: Are there explicit per-route quotas available today? Some customers want to throttle expensive endpoints separately.
ethan: We support per-route soft quotas and project-level hard quotas. Default soft behavior is queuing + metric alerts; hard quotas return 429 immediately. Ops maintains templates for common route profiles.
ops-bot: note: ORG-1145 created to add per-route quota templates to the admin UI.
devex: Can someone confirm the headers customers should parse to detect limits? I'll include them in the playbook.
ethan: GA headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`. We also have an experimental `X-Queue-ETA-ms` in canary. SDKs will publish helpers for parsing and backoff.
sam: For hosted API, is there a documented burst cap (per-minute or hourly) or only soft per-second limits?
maya: Customers want deterministic numbers for capacity planning.
julia: We'll publish typical defaults: hosted soft ~10 rps (600 rpm) per project; bursts are supported via brief queuing (default 60s). For deterministic bursts, recommend Dedicated with a prepaid burst pool.
finance-bot: FYI: prepaid burst pools are billed as a separate line item (prepaid minutes/GPU-hours) and consumption is deducted from that bucket.
sam: If a customer hits a soft throttle and is queued, do we show position or ETA?
ethan: Not by default; we're testing `X-Queue-ETA-ms` opt-in. For now customers can rely on `X-RateLimit-Reset` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.
devex: I'll draft a one-pager for CSM/Sales with: 1) headers to check, 2) cURL sample, 3) quick mitigation steps (batching, KV cache, Optimize suggestions), and 4) when to recommend Dedicated/burst pool. Expect draft by Wednesday.
lina: Action recap: 1) @julia publish credit expiry + promo exception FAQ entry 2) @devex publish rate-limit playbook 3) eng/ops follow ORG-1145 for per-route templates 4) finance to add sample pricing blurb for burst pools. Thanks all, I'll post the compiled follow-up doc to #docs when ready.
